about.description: At Brewista, coffee is more than just a drink—it is a daily ritual that brings people together. We carefully source premium coffee beans, roast them to perfection, and craft every beverage with passion and precision. Our mission is to deliver unforgettable coffee experiences in a warm and welcoming environment.
about.missionText: To inspire every coffee lover with handcrafted beverages made from the finest ingredients while creating memorable moments through outstanding quality and genuine hospitality.
about.visionText: To become a trusted coffee destination where innovation, craftsmanship, and community come together to create extraordinary coffee experiences.

faq.description: We are here to help! Find answers to the most common questions about our coffee, services, and more.

one.question: What type of coffee beans do you use?
one.answer: We use 100% premium Arabica beans, ethically sourced from the finest coffee-growing regions around the world to deliver rich aroma and exceptional flavor in every cup.

two.question: Are your ingredients natural and safe?
two.answer: Yes. We carefully select natural, high-quality ingredients and prepare every drink and treat in a clean, safe environment.

three.question: Do you offer any dairy-free or vegan options?
three.answer: Yes. We offer dairy-free milk alternatives and a selection of vegan-friendly drinks and treats. Please ask our team about today's options.

four.question: How can I place an order?
four.answer: You can place an order in-store or choose your favorite items from our menu and contact our team for assistance with your order.

five.question: Do you deliver to my area?
five.answer: We deliver to selected areas. Enter your location during checkout or contact us to confirm delivery availability.

six.question: How long does delivery take?
six.answer: Most deliveries arrive within 30 to 45 minutes, depending on your location, order size, and current café traffic.

seven.question: What is your return or refund policy?
seven.answer: If there is a problem with your order, contact us as soon as possible so our team can review it and help with a suitable replacement or refund.
